requirement: A post Tracy creates on EmDash is named in Site changes — by its title, never a bare id

oracle.invariant: The build check prints a count >= 1. site_write has a row action='content_create', via='emdash-mcp', outcome='ok', actor=A, target kind='posts', target id=POST_ID (before #774 the target was NULL: content_create carries no id; ACC-30.C4 on qaacc-em03, develop 1bf428e65). API item: origin.source='chat', description.key='resource.op', description.params.type='post', description.params.id=POST_ID, and description.key is not 'change.recorded' (before #774: change.recorded, shown as 'Content change recorded'). API item: description.params.op='create' when the turn's only ok emdash-mcp row is that content_create. API item: effects.content.resources has an entry with type='post', id=POST_ID and 'create' in ops. The row's description text names the post by its title REG-010-<RUN> and never shows the bare POST_ID (en reads 'Created post “REG-010-<RUN>”'; since #900 E3.2, a ULID is never shown — before it read 'Created post <POST_ID>').
oracle.productSourceGap: no deterministic run, so no code to follow; owner layer harness, needs stand, site:em, model, seat:owner

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
